title: Multilinguality in LLM-Designed Reward Functions for Restless Bandits: Effects on Task Performance and Fairness

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM-based reward design system in different languages (English, Hindi, Tamil, Tulu) and measuring how the prompt's language impacts task performance and the resulting fairness (Demographic Parity) of the resource allocations.

Calculating Demographic Parity variance (DP_variance) across discrete age buckets to evaluate whether the generated reward functions unfairly allocate resources to specific age groups as an unintended consequence.

Measuring Demographic Parity variance across socioeconomic features, specifically income levels, education levels, and phone ownership, to detect unintended disparities in public health resource allocation.
